note: Recorded from the hand-written pack in the commit that deleted it. Every expectation describes that pack, not the real service; a probe run replaces cells with observed evidence and cites the cassette.

steps.superseded: The pack stored one record per share and served it unchanged as a ResourceShare, as a ResourceShareAssociation and as a Resource. Those shapes disagree -- a share declares no resourceArns or principals, an association declares neither those nor a name -- so the pack's answers carried members no SDK could read. Each answer is projected to what its own shape declares; the members stay in the record, because the pack stored them, but nothing answers with them.
